description: A bench of small utilities: two attenuating mults, an LFO, four levelled channels, two crossfaders and two signal swappers

params.text: Scales what the upper mult sends to its outputs, from silence to the whole input
Scales what the lower mult sends to its outputs, from silence to the whole input
Crossfades between the two lower fade inputs, all A fully clockwise and all B fully anticlockwise
Exchanges the two lower swap outputs, one press over and the next back
Scales the LFO output, from silence to the whole wave
Chooses the LFO wave: triangle in the first position and square in the other two
Scales what reaches the A1 output
Scales what reaches the A2 output
Crossfades between the two A channels and the two B channels, all A at the top and all B at the bottom
Scales what reaches the B1 output
Scales what reaches the B2 output
Exchanges the two upper swap outputs, one press over and the next back
Sets a fixed voltage between 0-5V for any channel whose selector is in the voltage position
Sets the LFO to run bipolar between -5V and 5V, or unipolar between 0-10V
Sets the LFO frequency, doubling every volt of its setting, from 0.004Hz to 1024Hz
Scales the crossfader output, from silence to the whole signal
Chooses what feeds A1 and A2 when their own jacks are empty: the VOLTAGE knob, nothing, or an inverted triangle from the LFO
Chooses what feeds B1 and B2 when their own jacks are empty: the VOLTAGE knob, nothing, or an inverted square from the LFO

inputs.text: The signal the upper mult copies, scaled by the MULT slider on its way out
The signal the lower mult copies, scaled by the lower MULT knob on its way out
One of the two signals the upper swapper exchanges; with nothing patched it takes the upper mult input scaled by the MULT slider
One of the two signals the upper swapper exchanges; with nothing patched it takes the upper mult input scaled by the MULT slider and inverted
One of the two signals the lower swapper exchanges
One of the two signals the lower crossfader mixes between
A rising edge above 2V restarts the LFO from the start of its cycle
Nothing in the module reads this jack; what feeds the A and B channels when their own inputs are empty is set by the A and B selectors
The signal the A1 channel scales
The signal the A2 channel scales
The signal the B1 channel scales
The signal the B2 channel scales

outputs.text: Carries the upper mult input scaled by the MULT slider
Carries the upper mult input scaled by the MULT slider and inverted
Carries the lower mult input scaled by the lower MULT knob
Carries the lower mult input scaled by the lower MULT knob and inverted
Carries the B swap input while the swap button is unlit and the A swap input while it is lit
Carries the A swap input while the swap button is unlit and the B swap input while it is lit
Carries the lower B swap input while the lower swap button is unlit and the lower A swap input while it is lit
Carries the lower A swap input while the lower swap button is unlit and the lower B swap input while it is lit
The crossfade between the two lower fade inputs
Carries the A1 input scaled by the A1 slider, or with nothing patched whatever the A selector feeds it
Carries the A2 input scaled by the A2 slider, or with nothing patched whatever the A selector feeds it
Carries the B1 input scaled by the B1 slider, or with nothing patched whatever the B selector feeds it
Carries the B2 input scaled by the B2 slider, or with nothing patched whatever the B selector feeds it
The crossfade between the A channels and the B channels, scaled by the LVL knob
The LFO wave, between -5V and 5V when bipolar and 0-10V when unipolar, scaled by the LFO slider
